title: Generic formal fibre over the generic residue field
statement: theorem genericFormalFiber_bot_geometricallyRegular_of_finite_subring.{u} : ∀ (A : Type u) [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (A₀ : Subring A) [IsNoetherianRing ↥A₀] [Module.Finite (↥A₀) A] (P : Ideal A) [inst_5 : P.IsPrime], (let P₀ := Ideal.comap (algebraMap (↥A₀) A) P; let C₀ := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P₀)) (Localization.AtPrime P₀); Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular ⊥.ResidueField (⊥.Fiber C₀)) → let C := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)) (Localization.AtPrime P); Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular ⊥.ResidueField (⊥.Fiber C)

source.place: Proposition Tag 07PS and Lemma Tag 07PP, decomposition of the assigned proof

proof.text: Use finite module-finiteness to obtain a finite-type instance and quasi-finiteness at every prime of A.
Apply the quasi-finite formal-fibre ascent theorem to the finite subring inclusion, with the zero prime of A below P, and simplify the contraction of the zero prime along the injective subring map.

lean.statement: theorem genericFormalFiber_bot_geometricallyRegular_of_finite_subring (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (A₀ : Subring A) [IsNoetherianRing A₀] [Module.Finite A₀ A] (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hbase : let P₀ := P.comap (algebraMap A₀ A) let C₀ := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P₀)) (Localization.AtPrime P₀) Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular (⊥ : Ideal A₀).ResidueField ((⊥ : Ideal A₀).Fiber C₀)) : let C := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)) (Localization.AtPrime P) Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular (⊥ : Ideal A).ResidueField ((⊥ : Ideal A).Fiber C)
